transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get the daily movement-control huddle started. Before I finalize and publish the dispatch plan, I need each of you to confirm whether your section has any specific timing requirements or constraints for your respective runs. Motor pool — anything on vehicle status or availability changes? Logistics — any issues with the water or barrier-material runs? Signal — anything we need to know about the comms-equipment delivery? Medical — any cold-chain timing concerns for the clinic delivery?
